# Conditional run: blocks that predate the guard in
# .github/scripts/tests/test_no_conditional_run_blocks.py (FND-4244).
#
# This list only shrinks. Do not add to it: move the logic into a tested script
# under .github/scripts/ instead (docs/standards/ci.md). When you migrate a
# block, delete its line and lower ALLOWLIST_CEILING in the test to match.
#
# Format: <file>::jobs.<job_id>.<step id|name> (workflows)
#         <file>::runs.<step id|name>          (composite actions)
